scope: Twelve core/activation/lifecycle files reviewed. Collector implementation/declaration, fixture helper and new protocol test source are separately owned by Native/Root reviewers; this receipt does not substitute their full-package conclusion.
findings: Unchanged six product core files retain the v1 review: numeric diagnostic-only TLS uses synchronous try/finally, captures integers before existing awaits and restores around original calls; no additional promise/await, authorization reuse, snapshot tag, transport header or result proof.

Final helper defaults off unless the explicit Boolean flag is true in the top renderer frame. Phase views reason2/3 do not advance dump sequence/cursor; pagehide reason1 does. Key-limit failure now uses a dropped sequence entry, preserving recorded+dropped=through.

Final row validator checks per-event arity and enum fields, including incoming21, freshness branch-specific arity and invalidate cause0..2. Recorder has unchanged4096-row prefix and1024 local-key limits; raw payload/identity strings remain absent from dumps.

Final LiveChannel adds incoming21 immediately after the existing invalidationAfter.set, using the already created boundary and closed kind/revision fields. It records pushes even when no subscription matches; no extra readBoundary or business predicate is added.

diagnosticCause is the optional seventh invalidate parameter and appears only in its diagnostic tuple. onopen supplies the original effective undefined/false arguments and leaves after undefined, invoking its existing default readBoundary once. Late-connected subscribe adds cause2 without altering the preexisting supported/presence/coverage ternary. Scheduling, pending obligations, fallback, deadlines and catch-up are unchanged.

Main only passes --mikka-1512-read-diagnostic and installs the collector when MIKKA_1512_READ_DIAGNOSTIC is exactly1. Installation precedes original first load; privileged BrowserWindow options and existing listeners/loads are unchanged.
Preload exposes only a Boolean within the byte-identical original top-frame and own-origin/path guard. It does not expose a Node object, add IPC methods or alter bridge authorization.

Lifecycle alone maps MIKKA_1512_LIFECYCLE_READ_DIAGNOSTIC into internal child flag1/0; explicit0 prevents inherited internal activation when opt-in is absent. No model/account/business arguments are changed.

All original login query checkpoints remain in place. Native login closes its SQL window before prepareNativeDevice and recordNativeState; first cold-start SQL checkpoint and readiness duration finish before diagnostics; Web diagnostic collection occurs after its existing complete checkpoint. Five pairs, source windows and ordinary assertions/cleanup remain unmodified.

Native authenticated-profile dumps may include device-preparation events after the SQL window closed. Such records remain document-causal observations and must not be silently counted as login-window RPC. No extra settling await is added to complete records at a boundary.
Instrumentation adds bounded synchronous work and some post-window diagnostic copying. This is causal diagnosis only, not zero-perturbation timing evidence or a formal Native budget pass.
